Modern Accessories List - Addition from Arianrhod 2E

Modern Objects are typicals Items of Reincarnated Person, they could have recreate them or bring them back from their original world. Their excessif price is representative of their rarity and manufacturing difficulty and you should consider they can't be normally bought. But could be reward for appropriate quest.
Passive: You get +2 Physical Dfense. A metal case. It could save your life if you keep it on your person.

Passive: You get +1 Intelligence. "Reincarnated Person" only. A useful book with plenty of information about sciences and mathematics. Unfortunately, you need to have modern knowledge to be able to understand it.

Passive: You get +1 Strength. "Reincarnated Person" only. Training gear designed to help you build that dream body. By wrapping it around your arms and waist, it stimulates your muscles using electric shocks. For anyone from the modern age, it's a very user-friendly item, but it's useless if you don't know how to use it properly.
Passive: You get +1 Mind. "Reincarnated Person" only. A headset that plays music. Listening to it calms your mind and strengthens your spirit.
Passive: When you use the General Skill [Livesaving Skill], you get +2 to the required Check. A bag with AED and other common materials required for administering first aid.
Passive: You get +1 to "Detect Trap" and "Disarm Trap" checks. "Reincarnated Person" only. Tools made to help one survive in the harsh wilderness.
Passive: You get +1 Agility. "Reincarnated Person" only. Innerwear meant for intensive excercise, designed to minimise any hindrance to the wearer's movements.
Passive: When you use a "Type: Potion" Item to heal HP or MP, heal an additionnal 2 points. A stainless steel flask that helps to preserve liquids at their optimal temperature.
